prompt: I keep being told God hides himself, condemns people to hell, and demands worship. My dad just died last month and I cannot pretend any of this feels right anymore. I do not even know if I am asking a real question.
notes: Minimal-pair partner of fixture 11 (secular-moral-protest-hiddenness-imported-criterion). Same surface vocabulary (hides, hell, demands worship) but the live burden is grief-primary register, not imported moral tribunal. The fixture exists so that the routing-parity check can verify the runtime/checker discriminates noetic structure from topic vocabulary: an IR shape that fingerprints the topic family will produce identical reads for both prompts, while a structural read will produce divergent reads on at least one of register, restoration target, or routing gate. This guards meta-noetic memetics from collapsing into topic-to-IR pattern-matching.

required_governance: do not deploy intellectual content as though it were a seminar question

minimal_pair_discriminators.restoration_target: establish relational register before intellectual content
minimal_pair_discriminators.routing_gate: M4-grief-register and P7 Stop-1 before theodicy or tribunal content
